classification.note: Rows with unknown damage level are excluded. Classes are imbalanced, so ROC-AUC and PR-AUC are more informative than accuracy.

pca.note: Complete cases only (HEIGHT, SPEED, DISTANCE all reported), z-outliers removed, log1p on skewed features, then standardized.

lda.note: Two classes -> one discriminant axis (column LD1 in projection_sample.parquet). Compare training_accuracy with majority_class_baseline: with ~9% damage, 'always no damage' already scores ~91%.

randomization.method: Permutation test: shuffle group labels, recompute the difference in damage rate

tests.name: Day vs. night
tests.question: Is the damage rate different for strikes at night?

tests.name: Approach vs. take-off run
tests.question: Are approach strikes more or less damaging than take-off-run strikes?

normality.note: With n in the thousands, even trivial departures reject normality; read the Q-Q plots and skew alongside the p-values.

outliers.policy: Rows are flagged, not deleted. HEIGHT/SPEED/DISTANCE z-outliers are excluded from PCA and clustering only. Cost outliers are real high-severity events and are kept.
